pull.title: Blog: remove the AI-placeholder note and the placeholder frontmatter flag
pull.body:
## Intent

Remove the "This post is a placeholder and was written by AI..." note from every kody.codes blog post, and remove the flag that adds it so it can't come back.

**Door:** `two-way`

**Cleanup:** `done`

## Why

Kent asked for the note to be gone from all posts. 29 posts showed it: 28 never set `placeholder` (the old default was `true`) and 1 set `placeholder: true`.

## Summary

- Removed `BLOG_PLACEHOLDER_CALLOUT` from `universal/blog-display.ts`, the callout `<aside>` and its CSS from `start/pages/blog-post.tsx`, and the `placeholder` field from the parser, catalog, server loader, and `BlogPostLoaderData`.
- `placeholder` is no longer a known frontmatter key, so writing it fails the build like any other unknown key. Dropped the line from the 35 posts that set it.
- `docs/contributing/blog.md` no longer documents the flag. `@kentcdodds/kody-weekly-post` 0.1.4 stops emitting `placeholder: false` (template, AUTHORING.md, prompts).

## Referenced issues and PRs

Follow-up to #4839.

## Testing

- `node tools/run-node-tests.ts packages/worker/src/blog/` (10 passed). The old "invalid placeholder value" case now asserts `placeholder` is an unknown key.
- `run-tsc` for `tsconfig-start-server.json` and `tsconfig-start.json` pass. Pre-push hooks (typecheck, knip, related tests) pass.
- `grep` finds no copy of the note text anywhere in the repo.

const {
  githubApiErrorStatus,
  withGithubApiRetry,
} = require(path.join(
  process.env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE,
  "tools/ci/github-api-retry.cjs",
));

async function githubApi(label, run) {
  return withGithubApiRetry(run, {
    onRetry: ({ attempt, maxAttempts, delayMs, error }) => {
      const status = githubApiErrorStatus(error);
      core.warning(
        `GitHub API ${label} returned ${status ?? "5xx"}; retrying in ${delayMs}ms (attempt ${attempt}/${maxAttempts}).`,
      );
    },
  });
}

const marker = "<!-- ***-preview-url -->";
const previewUrl = process.env.PREVIEW_URL;
const loginDeepLink = `${previewUrl}/login?redirectTo=${encodeURIComponent("/account")}`;
const bodyLines = [
  marker,
  `🔎 Preview deployed: ${previewUrl}`,
  "",
  `Worker: \`${process.env.WORKER_NAME}\``,
];
if (process.env.PLATFORM_URL?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push(
    `Platform worker: \`${process.env.PLATFORM_WORKER_NAME}\` (${process.env.PLATFORM_URL.trim()})`,
  );
}
if (process.env.RUNTIME_URL?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push(
    `Runtime worker: \`${process.env.RUNTIME_WORKER_NAME}\` (${process.env.RUNTIME_URL.trim()})`,
  );
}
if (process.env.API_URL?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push(
    `API worker: \`${process.env.API_WORKER_NAME}\` (${process.env.API_URL.trim()})`,
  );
}
if (process.env.PREVIEW_VERSION_URL?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push(
    `Version preview: ${process.env.PREVIEW_VERSION_URL.trim()}`,
  );
}
if (process.env.D1_DATABASE_NAME?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push(`D1: \`${process.env.D1_DATABASE_NAME.trim()}\``);
}
if (process.env.OAUTH_KV_TITLE?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push(`KV: \`${process.env.OAUTH_KV_TITLE.trim()}\``);
}
bodyLines.push(
  "",
  "### Seed login (public preview fixture)",
  "",
  "- Email: `me@kentcdodds.com`",
  "- Password: `ilikecode`",
  "- Username: `user-me`",
  "",
  "Prefer MCP/API/`control-***` execute for proof. Browser only when UI is under test.",
  "",
  `- Deep link (UI login still needed): [Sign in → /account](${loginDeepLink}) — change \`redirectTo\` to the path under test (for example \`/@user-me/your-pkg\`).`,
  `- Already signed in (reuse CLI cookie): \`npm run control-*** -- browse --origin ${previewUrl} --path /account\``,
  "",
  "Do **not** post session cookies or tokens in PR comments.",
);
if (process.env.MOCK_SUMMARY?.trim()) {
  bodyLines.push("");
  bodyLines.push("Mocks:");
  bodyLines.push(process.env.MOCK_SUMMARY.trim());
}
const body = bodyLines.join("\n");

const { owner, repo } = context.repo;
const issue_number = context.payload.pull_request.number;

const comments = await githubApi("listComments", () =>
  github.paginate(github.rest.issues.listComments, {
    owner,
    repo,
    issue_number,
    per_page: 100,
  }),
);

const existing = comments.find((c) => c.body?.includes(marker));

if (existing) {
  await githubApi("updateComment", () =>
    github.rest.issues.updateComment({
      owner,
      repo,
      comment_id: existing.id,
      body,
    }),
  );
} else {
  // A 5xx after GitHub stored the create can leave a marker
  // comment behind; re-list before retrying so we update it
  // instead of posting a duplicate.
  let firstCreateAttempt = true;
  await githubApi("createComment", async () => {
    if (!firstCreateAttempt) {
      const latest = await github.paginate(
        github.rest.issues.listComments,
        { owner, repo, issue_number, per_page: 100 },
      );
      const created = latest.find((c) =>
        c.body?.includes(marker),
      );
      if (created) {
        return github.rest.issues.updateComment({
          owner,
          repo,
          comment_id: created.id,
          body,
        });
      }
    }
    firstCreateAttempt = false;
    return github.rest.issues.createComment({
      owner,
      repo,
      issue_number,
      body,
    });
  });
}
